dragInstructions: Press Space to pick up. Use the arrow keys to move, Space to drop, and Escape to cancel.
heatmapInstructions: Use Up and Down to move one day, Left and Right to move one week, and Home and End for the first and last day.
endHint: This week will stay in your history and update your stats.
carry: Carry unfinished work into next week
reopenHint: Work carried into next week will stay there. You can update this week and end it again.
clearHint: Remove this week's plan. You can undo this.
pasteHint: Paste copied JSON. Projects will be added to the week you are viewing.
keepProgress: Keep completion progress and missed days
oldDeadlines: This plan has deadlines before the destination week. Deadline dates will stay unchanged.
invalid: Invalid data. Please check it and try again.
occupied: The destination already has work or has ended.
error: Something went wrong. Your current plan is still safe.
loginPopupBlocked: Your browser blocked the sign-in window. Allow pop-ups and try again.
loginNetworkError: Could not connect to Google. Check your connection and try again.
loginDomainError: Sign-in is not allowed on this domain. Check Authorized domains in Firebase Authentication.
loginProviderError: Google sign-in is not enabled. Enable Google in Firebase Authentication and try again.
loginError: Google sign-in was unsuccessful. Try again; your plan is still saved on this device.
hasNote: Notes are available in task details
statsSubtitle: A look back at your completed weeks
weeksSubtitle: Your saved plans, ready when you need them
syncHint: Use the same account on your devices to sync your plan.
syncUnavailable: Sync is not available yet. Your plan is still saved on this device.
importHint: Import a weekdam backup. Data will be merged without replacing your entire plan.
mergeHint: This device and your account both have plans. Choose how to continue; the local copy stays available for backup.
guideText: Pick a project, write a task, and turn it into steps you can start.
emptyDayHint: Add a small step or move work here from another day.
emptyWeek: A new week. An easy start.
emptyStats: Your stats will appear after you end your first week.
emptyWeeks: The weeks you plan will appear here.
markMissed: Mark the previous day as missed
drag: Drag or press Space to move
clipboardFallback: Clipboard access is unavailable. Copy the text below.
